title: Driving While Intoxicated
grade_or_penalty: Motor vehicle offense. 1st: $250-$400 (BAC .08-<.10) or $300-$500 (.10+), 12-48 hrs IDRC, up to 30 days jail, interlock (BAC .15+: forfeiture 3 months after interlock install). 2nd: $500-$1,000, 30 days community service, 48 hrs-90 days jail, 1-2 yr forfeiture + interlock. 3rd+: $1,000, 180 days jail (up to 90 may be inpatient rehab), 8 yr forfeiture + interlock.
key_points: Operating a motor vehicle under the influence of alcohol, a narcotic, hallucinogenic or habit-producing drug, or with a BAC of 0.08% or more.
Also applies to an owner or person in control who lets an impaired driver operate.
Drug-impaired first offense: 7 months to 1 year license forfeiture.
P.L.2023, c.191 (approved Dec. 21, 2023) expanded interlock use and added interlock credits.
officer_notes: Penalties are for court reference; confirm current figures before quoting them to a defendant.
elements: The suspect operated a motor vehicle (or permitted another person who was impaired to operate one)
While under the influence of alcohol, a narcotic, hallucinogenic or habit-producing drug, OR with a BAC of 0.08% or higher
Document observations, SFSTs and breath, blood or DRE results

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: Operating a motor vehicle under the influence of alcohol or drugs, or with BAC of 0.08% or more; or permitting an impaired person to operate

subsections.label: a(1)
subsections.text: First offense: fines by BAC level, IDRC, possible jail, ignition interlock; forfeiture if BAC 0.15%+ or drug impaired

subsections.label: a(2)
subsections.text: Second offense: fines, 48 hours to 90 days jail, community service, 1-2 year forfeiture, interlock

subsections.label: a(3)
subsections.text: Third and later: $1,000 fine, 180 days jail, 8-year forfeiture, interlock
